_about: The one email Firebase still sends itself: the notice to the old address after a change of sign-in email, with a link to undo it. Paste the file into Firebase > Authentication > Templates > Email address change (Message, HTML), with this subject and sender name. Every other account email (password reset, email confirmation, the link to a new email, club invites) is sent by the API (server/src/utils/email/), so Firebase's own templates for those are never used. Previews of all of them: pnpm email:templates.
